title: Booking workflow audit
summary: Harbor Studio wants to reduce the manual work involved in booking workshops. We will document the current process, identify avoidable handoffs, and prepare a practical implementation plan.
deliverables:
Interviews with the bookings team and a map of the current workflow.
A prioritized backlog with effort estimates and acceptance criteria.
A clickable prototype of the proposed booking experience.
timeline: Three weeks, beginning when the bookings team and sample records are available.
assumptions: This engagement covers discovery and design. Production implementation will be estimated separately.
